title: agentic-sdlc repository configuration
description: Optional per-repository settings read from .agentic-sdlc.json at the repository root. Every key has a default; an absent file means the defaults.

protected_branches.description: Branches that only move by merged pull request. A force push to one of them is refused (PUSH-1).

mode.description: patterns: refuse attribution trailers, footers and the robot emoji that name a tool (ATTR-1). strict: also refuse any mention of a listed vendor in change text (ATTR-2).

vendors.description: Vendor and product names the attribution patterns match, case-insensitive.

post.description: Ask before every command that creates or changes something on a forge (ASK-3).

deny_add_all.description: Refuse git add -A, --all and a bare directory (STAGE-1).

scan_staged.description: Scan git diff --cached for key-shaped literals before a commit (SECRET-1).

use_gitleaks.description: Run gitleaks on the staged changes when it is on PATH; the built-in patterns run either way.

extra_patterns.description: Additional regular expressions treated as key-shaped literals.

extra_commands.description: Additional regular expressions, matched against each simple command, that count as a post and ask for confirmation (ASK-3).
